name: Slot Machine

features.name: Sticky coin respins

features.name: Coin-count multiplier
features.description: More coins mean a bigger multiplier.

review:
Slot Machine is a nostalgic 3x3, five-line game with a lever, blue layout and classic casino symbols. Three or more coin bonus symbols turn sticky and start a respin bonus.

The bonus gives three respins that reset with every new coin. The more coins you collect, the higher the multiplier you win. The bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 2,124x maximum and a 97% RTP. The bonus arrives roughly once every 95 spins. It shares its design with Panda Luck, without the theme.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 95 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
